formula_proof_steps.title: Produce the actual integration domains
formula_proof_steps.formula: 0\le F\le C\Longrightarrow F,\Phi(F)\in L^1(\mu\otimes\nu),\quad F(x,\cdot),\Phi(F(x,\cdot))\in L^1(\nu)\ (\forall x),\quad F(\cdot,y),\Phi(F(\cdot,y))\in L^1(\mu)\ (\forall y);\qquad 0\le A,B,m\le C.

formula_proof_steps.title: Construct a genuine positive comparison function
Use scalar logsum with the actual logarithm domains
formula_proof_steps.formula: a-\frac{bc}m\le\Phi(a)-a\log b-a\log c+a\log m;\qquad F-R\le\Phi(F)-F\log A-F\log B+F\log m.

formula_proof_steps.title: Integrate and use true weighted-log Fubini
Regularize without changing the public assumptions
formula_proof_steps.formula: \varepsilon_n=\frac1{n+1}\in(0,1],\quad\varepsilon_n\to0,\quad F_n=F+\varepsilon_n,\quad A_n=A+\varepsilon_n,\quad B_n=B+\varepsilon_n,\quad m_n=m+\varepsilon_n;\qquad J_{A_n}+J_{B_n}\le J_{F_n}+\Phi(m_n).

formula_proof_steps.title: Take only continuous entropy terms to the zero limit
formula_proof_steps.formula: J_{A_n}\to J_A,\quad J_{B_n}\to J_B,\quad J_{F_n}\to J_F,\quad\Phi(m_n)\to\Phi(m);\qquad J_A+J_B\le J_F+\Phi(m).
